heading: Suppression list
description: Addresses the server will not send to, for example after a permanent bounce. Taking one off lets it receive mail again.
unreachable: The mail server's management API is unreachable. Check that the server is running and the panel is configured.
removeError: Could not remove the address. Please try again.
confirm: Take {address} off the suppression list? The server will send mail to it again.
removed: Address taken off the suppression list.
